items.title: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
items.summary: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.GA

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
items.summary: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting. GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents
items.summary: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI, and makers get this simply by connecting a

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Introducing an App- and Intent-First Agent Creation Experience
items.summary: Copilot Studio is evolving to an app-first agent creation experience. Makers start with the application their agent will work with and configure the capabilities it needs. This update brings tools and knowledge into a more unified experience, simplifying how agents are created and configured.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
items.summary: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - New Survey Owner role provides access to survey results
items.summary: When a new program is being set up in Glint, there is now an option to designate Survey Owners. Those added as Survey Owners will be able to view and manage certain aspects of the program, as well as see the results when a survey in the program closes.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Streamlining experiences from Copilot Studio Agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.summary: This update is meant to bridge the experience of using Copilot Studio agents in M365 Copilot with the Copilot Chat experience. With these updates, agent responses in Copilot Chat will look (similar formatting, compressed chain of thought), feel (smoother streaming, resume/retry and voice dictation) and behave (deliver clickable citations and tool execution traces) very similarly to Copilot Chat responses themselves.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Enabling makers to require human approval for tool calls
items.summary: Copilot Studio now let’s makers require human approval before an agent runs specific tools. With a per-tool, per-agent toggle, any gated tool call pauses and shows an approval request describing what the agent intends to do, so a person can approve, approve for the session, or deny before the action runs. This gives organizations a deterministic guardrail for high-stakes or sensitive operations like sending emails, closing tickets, or processing payments, independent of the agent's instructions.

items.summary: We’re excited to announce that Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service is now available in the GCC-High (GCC-H) environment! Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service enables rapid ingestion of organizational/HR data through connectors from multiple HRIS systems using a single unified ingestion point. items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics in GCC-High
items.summary: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud High (GCC High), providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the GCC High environment.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: SharePoint: PowerShell support for brand fonts deletion
items.summary: Microsoft SharePoint is introducing PowerShell support for deleting brand font files from the Brand Fonts library used by the SharePoint Brand Center. With the new Remove-SPOFontFile cmdlet, SharePoint administrators can remove brand font files that are no longer approved, licensed, or needed across their organization in SharePoint.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Default Protection Controls for Exchange Online in the event of classification failure
items.summary: Default protection controls for Exchange Online is available in public preview. This release gives administrators fine-grained control to create DLP policies based on specific classification or text extraction failure types — such as timeout, throttling and other scan errors — rather than one blanket policy for all failure conditions. GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Enhanced Security Accounts Manager (sAM) Account Name support for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
items.summary: Enhanced support for synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) with Microsoft Entra Domain Services is now in Public Preview. This feature allows sAMAccountName to be populated from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute in Microsoft Entra ID. Existing managed domains can enable the new synchronization behavior, while it is enabled by default for new managed domains. items.title: Excel: Excel canvas
items.summary: A Copilot-generated canvas that turns workbook data into a polished, interactive view of key visualizations, metrics, and insights. As workbook data changes, it automatically updates to reflect the latest information. Users can modify the canvas by chatting with Copilot.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Identity: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
items.summary: The updated identity timeline provides security teams with a single chronological view of activity and alerts associated with an identity and its linked accounts. It normalizes activity from integrated Microsoft security products, including Microsoft Entra sign-ins, Microsoft Graph audit events, SaaS and cloud activity, and device logons. New fields and filters include Source table, Session ID, and Unique token identifier, with expanded Conditional Access and event context.GA date: September CY2

items.summary: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs. This capability allows customers and ISV apps to do a point in time restore of Entra objects to a last known good state to a rolling historical 30-day point.
